FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: Price above MA20 signals bullish momentum
US Treasury sale lifts yields, supporting USD
Geopolitical risk boosts safe‑haven demand for USD

FX.comment: Bullish bias driven by higher US yields and geopolitical risk-off sentiment
